knowledgeBase.sourceSummary: Sources include drawing text with a visual-review description and a confirmed Ridgeway supplier profile. This draft requires engineer editing and explicit approval before approved phone use.

openQuestions: What material, stock dimensions and finish are required? MATERIAL and FINISH are blank; stock is not specified in the supplied text.

Which tolerances apply to each feature, can the supplier achieve them, and what inspection method should be used? The drawing lists default tolerances, but capability and inspection evidence are absent.
